name: TautWeekly-for-Plex
extra_parameters: --read-only --tmpfs /tmp:rw,noexec,nosuid,size=256m,mode=1777 --stop-timeout 1800 --security-opt no-new-privileges:true --cap-drop ALL --cap-add CHOWN --cap-add DAC_OVERRIDE --cap-add FOWNER --cap-add SETGID --cap-add SETUID
description: Generate preview-first weekly Plex activity newsletters using Tautulli. The WebUI opens the authenticated TautWeekly Manager for setup, verification, previews, test delivery, and embedded scheduling. After installation, retrieve the one-time pairing token from the container Console with: /opt/tautweekly/bin/run-as-user.sh /opt/tautweekly/bin/tautweekly-manager access-bootstrap --data-dir /data/manager. The pairing token is never written to logs. Unraid owns container lifecycle and stable image updates.

paths.name: Appdata
paths.description: Private configuration, Manager credentials, state, backups, logs, assets, and generated previews. Preserve this path across updates and reinstalls.

ports.name: Manager Web UI
ports.description: Authenticated Manager for a trusted LAN. Do not expose plain HTTP publicly; use an explicitly configured TLS reverse proxy when remote access is required.

variables.name: Timezone
variables.description: IANA timezone used by the weekly scheduler, for example America/Phoenix.

variables.name: PUID
variables.description: Non-root Unraid user ID used for appdata ownership.

variables.name: PGID
variables.description: Non-root Unraid group ID used for appdata ownership.

variables.name: UMASK
variables.description: Restrictive file-creation mask for configuration and output.

variables.name: Runtime profile
variables.description: Validated unified-image behavior profile. Keep unraid for this template.

variables.name: Preview Base URL
variables.description: Optional LAN URL embedded in preview links, for example http://tower:8787. Never use a public URL.

variables.name: Manager Allowed Hosts
variables.description: Optional comma-separated DNS hostnames accepted by the Manager, for example tower,tautweekly.example.test. IP-literal access needs no entry. Do not include schemes, paths, ports, or wildcards.

variables.name: Secure Manager Cookies
variables.description: Set true only when every browser connection uses HTTPS through a correctly configured TLS reverse proxy. Plain HTTP login cannot work while enabled.

variables.name: Package Kind
variables.description: Identifies the Unraid-owned update path to the Manager. Keep this at the value supplied by Community Apps.

variables.name: Host Adapter API
variables.description: Package compatibility marker used to detect an older saved Unraid template. Keep this at the value supplied by the current Community Apps template.
